sources.title: DINOv2: Learning Robust Visual Features without Supervision
sources.snippet: Abstract The recent breakthroughs in natural language processing for model pretraining on large quantities of data have opened the way for similar foundation models in computer vision. These models could greatly simplify the use of images in any system by producing general-purpose visual features, i.e., features that work across image distributions and tasks without finetuning.
